phases.name: Repair missing validation artifact
phases.command: node -e "console.log('phase command passed before artifact exists');"

repairs.name: Create repaired artifact
repairs.command: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('outputs', { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync('outputs/repaired.txt', 'repaired\n'); console.log('repair created artifact');"

phases.name: Continue after repair
phases.command: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('outputs/continued.txt', 'continued\n'); console.log('continued after repair');"
